requiredFindings.summary: The supplement runner does not bind the architecture checkout and verifier used for the run to the reviewed architecture base.
requiredFindings.detail: The runner checks product P/W HEAD against productBase but never checks A HEAD against manifest.architectureBase, then invokes A/tools/verify_design.py even though that checker is absent from the 20 gate pins and the frozen architecture-input list. Architecture or verifier drift can therefore pass every guard and produce evidence outside the reviewed subject.
requiredFindings.requiredAction: Freeze a corrected runner that binds the architecture checkout used by the supplement to manifest.architectureBase and prevents use of an unpinned working-tree verifier, for example by using a clean detached architecture checkout at that commit or by adding an exact checker/dependency pin with an equivalent tracked-state guard; rebuild the subject manifest and request review.

failure diagnosis.detail: Frozen evidence and exact public sources support both setup diagnoses: the Rust socket path was 109 bytes against the Darwin less-than-104-byte requirement, and all 21 companion errors occurred in fixture setup because the synthetic product omitted the two VCS_ANCHORS paths. The 25 discovery controls and design check passed.

existing-gate compatibility.detail: A separately reviewed public/synthetic lane can close the remaining verification without a real blind-mode retry or privacy expansion while preserving the original failed postchecker and successful real outputs. Exact root substantive assent to a corrected supplement is the required new owner decision; this review does not provide it.

synthetic fixture parity.detail: The candidate is the pinned parent plus exactly one additive VCS_ANCHORS copy-set line. All 21 test bodies, assertions and expectations are unchanged, and the adapter preserves the original helper/import root and asserts 21 discovered tests.

executable guards.detail: The runner has the other requested static/live, before/after and stop-on-failure guards, but lacks the material architecture HEAD/verifier binding described by OWNPAT-CBRPC-R1-RF-1.

deferred product repair.detail: A successful corrected supplement still requires full post-run review and root assent before the four-file commit, and the one-line fixture correction remains a separate test-only product unit with its own validation and integration.
